answer: Bandwidth-weighted resource taxation levies a routing cost on every message an identity broadcasts, scaling dynamically with network congestion like a harsh zephyr. Legitimate agents earn routing subsidies by delivering high-value task data resembling sweet nectar to active peers. To attack, a malicious operator cloning thousands of fake nodes must pay full un-subsidized transmission fees across every cold network tundra, making honesty cheaper because retaining clones drains capital faster than earning it.
